snippet.title: Goryuujin + Electro (五竜陣＋エレクトロ) - Collectable Mode Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
This playthrough runs through one cycle of Collectable Mode. When looking at the World Overview, there are a total of 30 dots, but only 10 stages are randomly selected in one game. Replaying the game doesn't guarantee the system will pick the unknown worlds over the unlocked ones, so it would take several playthroughs to unlock all 30 dots. Since randomness factor are involved in unlocking all the worlds, it would be very difficult to unlock all worlds in one playthrough. So I just played through one cycle and done with it.


0:00 Opening
1:20 Main Menu
1:34 World Overview
1:53 Stage 1 - Domino
3:15 Stage 2 - Color
4:39 Stage 3 - Silkcolor
5:59 Stage 4 - Bubble
7:46 Stage 5 - Moyou3
8:58 Stage 6 - Bonus
10:21 Stage 7 - Bamboo
11:49 Stage 8 - Mandara
13:14 Stage 9 - Kome
14:33 Last Stage - Mosaic
15:48 Ending
16:01 Credits
